voice.continueLine: Extra sauce. On the continue. I do not care that it is a screen. Coin.
voice.selectLine: Strawe. The possum found a straw. The straw found a target. That is you.
tauntLines: I shot a spitball through a brick. Your face is softer than a brick.
The straw is bendy. The aim is not.
Extra sauce on everything. You are everything.
voice.endingText: Strawe put a spitball through the moon. The moon is fine. The spitball is still going.

parodyMeta.bootlegOf: the ranged member of a four-reptile sewer ninja team, who fights with a straw blowgun
parodyMeta.gag: Named after what the sensei found in a dumpster; he talks through the straw, so every threat comes out as a whistle, and he wants extra sauce on everything
tells: Wears a paper straw wrapper over his eyes as a mask, with the holes punched in the wrong place
